svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI PR CODE REVIEW, SAST REACHABILITY & COMPILE-VERIFIED AUTOFIX
1-Hop LSP Context + SAST Reachability + Compile-Verified Autofix Cuts PR Noise to 4.2%
2,500 Devs / 40,000 PRs/Mo: Tier 1 Raw Diff Bot (74% Noise, Muted by Devs) vs. Tier 2 Raw SAST (84.5% FP) vs. Tier 4 ($29K/mo, 88.6% Accept)
⛔ Tier 1–3 Traps: 74% PR Noise & Broken Autofixes
1. Raw `git diff` Only Sent to LLM (74.0% Noise & 48% Miss Rate):
• Blind to caller/callee signatures outside the 3-line diff hunk;
spams PRs with style nits & hallucinated bugs until devs mute it!
2. Unfiltered SAST / SCA Scanner Dump (84.5% False Positives):
• Blocks PRs over unreachable transitive CVEs or SQL queries
already sanitized by custom middleware one file away
3. Uncompiled `Suggested Changes` (Tier 3: 32% Break CI Build):
• Posting autofix patches without typechecking breaks builds on click
Production Failure Impact (2,500 Devs / 40,000 PRs/Mo):
• False-Positive / Nit Noise: 74.0% (Tier 1) | 84.5% (Tier 2)
• Developer Pre-Merge Fix Acceptance: Only 14.0%–16.0%
• Monthly Wasted Dev Review & AppSec TCO: $225,000 / month
🏆 Tier 4: 1-Hop LSP + Reachability + Verified Autofix
1. `Tree-Sitter / LSP` 1-Hop Caller/Callee & Type Hydrator:
• Automatically pulls modified symbol callers, callees & struct
definitions across files (lifts bug/vuln catch from 52% to 94.8%!)
2. `CodeQL / Semgrep` AST Reachability + Critic Gate (`>=0.85`):
• Suppresses unreachable CVEs, sanitized flows & trivial style
nits—cutting false-positive PR noise from 84.5% down to 4.2%!
3. Sandbox Typecheck-Verified `GitHub Suggested Change` Patcher:
• Runs `tsc / javac / ruff` on every patch before posting (88.6% accept)
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Cross-File Bug & Vuln Catch: 94.8% (+42.8 pts vs. Raw Diff Bot)
• False-Positive Noise: 4.2% | 1-Click Autofix Accept: 88.6%
• Monthly Total TCO: $29,000 / mo (-87.1% savings vs. Tier 1)
